subject: Request: baseline per-1M token IO pricing & supported models
messages:

Subject: Quick: per-1M token IO rates & model roster for hosted API

Hi Priyom,

We're kicking off an evaluation of hosted APIs for clinical summarization and note generation. Legal and procurement are asking for a simple baseline: standard per-1M token input + output rates, plus a short list of supported models and any performance/latency notes you can share.

Can you send a one-pager or rate table we can attach to the RFP? We don't need enterprise terms yet — just public hosted pricing and which models are included under that pricing tier.

Thanks,

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: per-1M token IO rates & model roster for hosted API

Hi Sofia — thanks for reaching out and great to hear NovaClin is evaluating hosted options. Attached is our baseline summary (Redwood_Baseline_Rate_Card_v1.pdf) and a compact model roster (Model_Lineup_Summary_2027.csv). High level: 

- Public hosted list pricing (standard tier):
  • Input: $0.20 per 1,000 input tokens
  • Output: $1.60 per 1,000 output tokens
  • That maps to $200 / 1M input tokens and $1,600 / 1M output tokens.

- Models included in standard hosted tier: G-Open-3B (fast, low-cost), G-Open-13B (balanced), Redwood-Chat-Large (higher-quality chat generation). See the CSV for latency SLOs at 512-token prompts.

Notes: these are our publicly listed baseline IO rates for the hosted product. We do provide volume discounts and term-based pricing for committed usage — happy to outline those if you can share an expected monthly token profile (IO split).

Next steps: if procurement wants the one-pager in a specific format (Excel or procurement template), send it over and I’ll populate. Also looping Ben on this thread for any questions on discounting thresholds.

Best,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai
Attachment: Redwood_Baseline_Rate_Card_v1.pdf, Model_Lineup_Summary_2027.csv

From: procurement@novaclin.com
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 09:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: per-1M token IO rates & model roster for hosted API

Priyom — thanks for the packet. A couple quick clarifying questions from the procurement team: 

1) Are input/output measured as billed tokens (post-tokenizer) or approximate characters? We want to align with our cost model.
2) Do the listed models share the same IO rates, or do higher-capacity models carry a premium?
3) We typically negotiate a 12-month committed spend for discounting. Can you outline discount bands (e.g., 10% at $X/month, 20% at $Y/month)?

Also, can you confirm whether the standard tier includes streaming and function-calling (we will use both)?

Appreciate a short bullet response so we can include in the RFP appendix.

—NovaClin Procurement

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: procurement@novaclin.com, Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@novaclin.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: per-1M token IO rates & model roster for hosted API

Hi team — short answers below to help your RFP appendix: 

1) Billing unit: billed tokens are measured post-tokenizer (we charge on model-token usage after tokenization). We can supply a short sample tokenizer report if helpful.

2) Model rates: baseline IO rates above apply to the standard hosted tier (covers our curated open models and Redwood-verified variants). Premium Redwood-Chat-Large carries a 25% premium on output tokens for high-quality chat-generation workloads; this is noted in the CSV.

3) Discount bands (12-month commitment examples):
  • 10% off list at $50k/month commit (12mo)
  • 18% off list at $150k/month commit (12mo)
  • 30% off list for enterprise reserved capacity discussions (custom terms)

Streaming & function-calling: included in the hosted API (standard tier), no add-on charge.

If you can share a projected monthly IO split (approx input vs output tokens) and a target commit level, Ben and I will prepare a clean offer sheet (Excel) with line-item math and a proposed SOW. Happy to jump on a 30-minute call if that speeds things up.

Thanks — Priyom
